items.rationale: Sections 2.3.3, 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f) exclude translation costs even when the police report is required for cover.
Sections 7.1.8(e)–(f) exclude the provider's working materials and ancillary charges billed alongside an excluded translation.

Section 7.1.9 excludes the upgrade premium, and the equivalent pre-loss watch is expected to exceed the €2,500 unscheduled valuables cap under 4.2.2 and 4.4. After applying the caps, the €150 event deductible is allocated proportionally: €2,500 minus €125.

The roughly €900 nominal loss is capped at €500 under 2.3.2 and 4.2.3; the capped watch and cash together are below the €5,000 away-from-home ceiling. The cash line's proportional share of the single €150 deductible is €25, leaving €475.
Sections 2.3.4(a) and 7.1.10 exclude the sunglasses because they were mislaid separately and were not taken in the robbery.
Sections 5.2.3 and 7.1.8(b) exclude shipping, whether for replacement property or for documents.
